exempt.no-bare-react-native-ui: This plugin exists to prove the shared UI kit is not the only way to build a Paseo surface (xpufx-org/paseo#629). Its layout kit is client/kit.tsx, hand-built on react-native. Importing the helper's own primitives would defeat the plugin's purpose.
exempt.no-bespoke-react-native-interactions: Same as no-bare-react-native-ui: the Pressable-based interactions in client/kit.tsx are the point of the plugin, not an accident. See xpufx-org/paseo#629.
